# Template vocabulary — accepted terms that the template's own prose (the
# rendered docs/** pages and README sections) needs Vale's spell-check to
# know. Template-owned: re-rendered on every `copier update`, so a term
# the template adds alongside new prose arrives with that prose (#366).
# Do not edit here; project terms go in ../Base/accept.txt. One term per
# line, matched case-insensitively. See https://docs.vale.sh/keys/vocabularies.
#
# Kept alphabetical within each category. A term listed here must occur in
# template prose; scripts/tests/test_vale_vocabulary.py checks that.
